name: AXM Deterministic Continuation Capsule
actions: bind a declared active goal, decisions, open loops, boundaries, and logical source locators to exact source digests
compile a path-independent capsule without embedding linked source content
preserve REPROBE_REQUIRED for volatile external facts even when stored digests match
render a compact digest-bound resume card for a later local AXM or Codex instance
refuse sources declared private, raw-log, repetitive-telemetry, temporary-capture, or unclassified, plus permission inference, promotion, roots, and CANON
summary: Compile exact evidence-linked continuation state into a compact verifiable resume card without granting hidden memory or action authority.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL adapter over two reference-only Memory & Continuity Garden candidates. It does not activate their semantic runtime or memory.handoff permission and is not CANON.
